title: Juggernaut - Affiliate SaaS Landing Page 💶
palette_note: near-white page washed with low-opacity sky-blue and faint peach aura gradients; one vivid cyan carries badges, links and the chart stroke, while pure black is held back for CTAs only

type.note: very large tight-tracked black headline (~64px) against 14px grey body; table headers set as 10px letterspaced ALL-CAPS; numerals use a lighter tint on the cents

layout.note: two-column hero, big type left and a floating product card right; supporting UI fragments deliberately cropped off the canvas edges; faded greyscale logo wall; page sits as a white sheet on a light grey canvas

style_signature: Near-white page with soft sky-blue and peach aura gradients bleeding behind crisp white product cards, ultra-tight black grotesque headlines, and a single cyan used only for badges and data strokes.

title: AI SaaS Landing Page
palette_note: one high-chroma acid chartreuse used as a surface fill across entire panels rather than as a small accent, paired with a near-black olive; everything else stays neutral white and grey

type.note: soft geometric display with wide counters at ~56px; body dropped to 13px grey; oversized currency numerals inside cards do the visual heavy lifting

imagery: warm lifestyle photography plus UI fragments

layout.note: stacked full-width rounded white slabs floating on a grey canvas; colour-blocked bento inside each slab; pill buttons with arrow glyphs; very generous internal padding

style_signature: Entire panels flooded in one acid chartreuse against deep olive-black, arranged as big rounded white slabs on grey, with warm sunlit lifestyle photography and oversized geometric currency numerals.

title: Schedulo — AI Shift Management Drawer in SaaS Booking Management
palette_note: white UI over a grey-dimmed app scrim; cyan owns every interactive state, pale sky #C0E4FC fills every timeline bar, and one hot red is reserved exclusively for peak-hour alarm bars

type.note: friendly geometric with tall x-height and rounded terminals; only two sizes really in play — 20px semibold titles and 13px regular labels; time-axis numerals switch to red when in the peak window

layout.note: near-full-bleed drawer over the dimmed app; frozen employee-name column, hairline-ruled gantt grid centre, insight rail right; sticky footer splitting ghost Cancel from filled primary

style_signature: A giant white drawer floating on a dim-grey scrim, a pale-sky gantt grid ruled entirely in hairlines, and one cyan that carries every interactive state while red is rationed to alarm bars.

title: Floware — Warehouse SaaS Platform Dashboard Website Landing Page
palette_note: cool lavender-tinted white canvas with pure white cards; one fully saturated electric blue on CTAs and links, and thin green/orange vector routes as the only other chroma

type.note: restrained 44px Title Case headline, no display drama; the shot's typographic character comes from the 9–11px UI micro-labels packed inside the render

layout.note: page presented as a rounded white sheet on grey; hero render bleeds off the right edge; 2-up and 3-up hairline cards; faint diagonal connector lines drawn across whole sections as background scaffolding

style_signature: A ghost-white isometric warehouse render threaded with hairline green and orange route lines, small floating micro-UI panels docked to it, and one electric blue CTA on a lavender-tinted white page.

title: UPS Platform - SaaS Airfreight Delivery Dashboard
palette_note: desaturated sage studio backdrop stepping down into one vivid jade green for the 3D props and the single primary pill; app screens stay bone-white with charcoal chips and a lime micro-highlight

type.note: tight geometric headers with a typographic '№' flourish; cargo IDs set as ALL-CAPS alphanumeric codes at 10px; body kept very small so the screen reads as an instrument panel

layout.note: two phones staged at converging angles on a stepped 3D plinth with glossy spheres; on-screen a grid of hatched slot tiles above stacked list rows and a floating pill action bar

style_signature: Bone-white minimal phone UI staged on a stepped sage-to-jade 3D set with glossy spheres, where one vivid green pill is the only saturated element on the screen itself.

title: React Datagrid for Saas web apps and dashboards
palette_note: essentially achromatic — paper-white rows on a cool grey-lavender field, slate-navy ink; one electric blue does checkboxes, the drag rule and the selected-row tint and nothing else

type.note: one family throughout, medium headers over regular cells with tabular figures; no display type at all — the shot's drama comes from presenting the component at roughly 2× zoom

layout.note: table cropped edge-to-edge by the frame; hairline row rules and near-invisible zebra; two stacked context menus with 8px radius and soft shadow; the giant crop is itself the composition

style_signature: A component blown up to 2× scale: paper-white rows on hairline rules, slate-navy ink, soft-shadow floating menus with outline icons, and one electric blue rationed to selection state.

title: Saas Landing  page design
palette_note: true black canvas with barely-separable #0C0C0C cards; a single electric blue for eyebrows, icons and mono metrics; a violet-blue nebula streak is the only light source in the whole page

type.note: huge tight-tracked white headline, tiny letterspaced ALL-CAPS blue section eyebrows (AGENTS, PRICING, CUSTOMERS), and monospace for regions, latency figures and agent logs

layout.note: sections separated by 1px near-black rules that only just read; centred hero, then alternating two-column blocks and 3-up bordered cards; the featured pricing card is filled with a blue-tinted wash rather than outlined

style_signature: True black everywhere, cards drawn only with barely-visible 1px hairlines, a single violet-blue light streak behind the hero, and electric blue confined to micro-labels, icons and monospace metrics.

title: SaaS Platform Landing Page for Startups
palette_note: a strict three-value system — pure black, off-white, and one royal blue flooded across the featured pricing card, every primary pill and the in-product promo tile

type.note: friendly geometric display with generous round counters at ~60px set in Title Case; grey 15px body; pricing tier names set large in the same family, with the highlighted tier flipping to blue-on-white

layout.note: full-bleed alternating black and white bands; centred hero; the dashboard screenshot deliberately straddles the seam between white and black bands; 3-up pricing with the middle card scaled up and flooded blue

style_signature: Hard-edged full-bleed bands of pure black and off-white with exactly one royal blue, pill buttons throughout, and a product screenshot placed to straddle the seam between two bands.

title: CyberGuard - Cybersecurity SaaS  Dashboard
palette_note: a 1970s print palette — chalky putty-sage field with flat coral and mustard tiles and a forest-green block; mid saturation, zero gradients, and no colour ever used at full brightness

type.note: hairline-thin high-contrast numerals at poster scale ('57', '64', '12/102') sitting beside a felt-pen script headline; all labels drop to a plain small grotesque

layout.note: flat bento of hard-edged colour tiles with no radius and no shadow; a giant dotted radial gauge anchors the centre; diagonal-hatch bar fills; stacked alert banners offset like printed sheets

style_signature: Chalky putty-sage ground carrying hard-edged coral and mustard tiles, hairline-thin poster numerals, dotted radial gauges and a handwritten marker headline — print-poster grammar applied to a security dashboard.

title: Service selection Modal Flow for saas web app dashboard
palette_note: monochrome cool greys with one emerald that carries the selected ring, the radio dot, the confirm button and every icon illustration; a lilac 'Recommended' pill is the single break

type.note: one grotesque only, bold 28px title over regular 16px rows; prices set semibold with the '/blog post' unit dropped to light grey — a deliberate two-tone price treatment

layout.note: centred large-radius modal over a fully blurred page; four stacked full-width selectable rows, the chosen one ringed in 2px emerald; footer splits ghost Cancel left from filled confirm right

style_signature: A large-radius white modal over an entirely blurred page, stacked selectable rows where only the chosen one gains a 2px emerald ring, with glossy gradient app-icon tiles as the only imagery.

title: SaaS Landing Page Design | Product Analytics Platform (UI/UX)
palette_note: a pale sky-to-peach gradient over photoreal moss-green hills; the interface itself stays black-and-white apart from one small green status pill — all colour comes from the image, none from the UI

type.note: high-contrast transitional serif headline that switches from regular to bold mid-sentence for emphasis, set against monospace body copy and monospace nav — the serif/mono pairing is the entire voice

imagery: photoreal landscape imagery plus product screenshot

layout.note: everything inside one large rounded page card on grey; centred hero with acres of sky; the dashboard screenshot sits half-submerged behind the hill crest; the logo row rides on the green

style_signature: One rounded page card holding a misty sky-to-peach gradient above photoreal green hills, a high-contrast serif headline that changes weight mid-sentence, and monospace for every other word on the page.

title: LeonAnd — Minimal SaaS Analytics Dashboard
palette_note: near-white UI floating on a defocused sky-and-dry-grass photograph; charts drawn in a single deep teal with a muted peach for the one negative metric — the warm brown bokeh supplies all remaining saturation

type.note: magazine masthead grammar — letterspaced 10px ALL-CAPS eyebrows ('VOL. IV · ISSUE 117', 'SECTION 01 · TOP-LINE') above a 40px sentence-case headline that ends in a full stop; currency figures set inline in monospace within running prose

imagery: defocused photographic backdrop, no in-UI imagery

layout.note: translucent sidebar letting the photograph through, then an inset white content sheet with generous margins; a four-column KPI row divided by hairlines; charts reduced to single thin strokes with tiny tinted area fills

style_signature: Analytics dressed as a magazine — letterspaced ALL-CAPS issue numbers, a headline ending in a period, monospace figures inline in prose — all on a translucent white sheet over a defocused nature photograph.

title: Property Management Mobile SaaS
palette_note: bone-grey studio and a bone-white app that are almost the same value; a single amber gradient blob and one thin amber tick mark are the only colour in the entire frame

type.note: hairline-light geometric with wide apertures used at every size; the '133' hero numeral is set at display scale in the same thin weight — nothing is bold except one active tab label

imagery: 3D staged mockup with small photographic thumbnails

layout.note: phone rotated ~30° and cantilevered off raw concrete blocks; on-screen everything is a hairline-ruled panel with vast empty space around one centred hero number and a filmstrip of property thumbnails

style_signature: Hairline-light geometric type and one centred display numeral on a bone-white screen, warmed by a single amber gradient blob, staged at a steep angle on raw concrete blocks.

title: SaaS Web Dashboard
palette_note: warm-neutral greys with a single coral for the primary action and the active nav tile; category chips are the only other colour and each is a barely-saturated pastel — lilac, mint, peach, sky

type.note: compact grotesque, semibold 15px card titles over 13px grey body; column counts set beside the column name in a lighter weight so headers read as one phrase

layout.note: icon rail plus nav column plus a kanban board that runs off the right edge; cards are grey-tinted panels inside white columns, each with a progress bar and a meta counter row; a black editorial promo card is slotted into the sidebar

style_signature: Warm-grey kanban with barely-saturated pastel category chips, one coral primary button, and a black editorial promo card wedged into the sidebar, shot on a laptop against a taupe gradient wall.

title: Costar - Real Estate SaaS Dashboard
palette_note: the interface is achromatic white and grey; risk is coded in one saturated orange against a bright green, and the whole frame is bathed in a peach-to-grey ambient wash from the photographic set

type.note: quirky rounded geometric display with near-circular bowls for property titles, dropping to a plain small grotesque for data labels; metric figures set large in a light weight with a smaller unit suffix

imagery: architectural photography inside the UI, photographic staging around it

layout.note: hard vertical split — a photo-led property panel left, a card grid of risk metrics right; radar chart, sparkline cards and hairline separators; framed over a silhouetted shoulder so half the left panel is occluded

style_signature: A white dashboard split hard down the middle — full-bleed building photograph on one side, hairline metric cards with orange/green risk coding on the other — staged over a silhouetted shoulder in a peach ambient glow.
